faqs.q: Is VPN included or a separate product?
faqs.a: VPN is included on every SecuEdge Frontier model. SecuConnect, a dedicated VPN product, is on the roadmap for very large remote workforces.

faqs.q: How many remote users can I support?
faqs.a: Count each VPN user three times when sizing. Our model finder does this for you.

faqs.q: Can I add a second factor at login?
faqs.a: Ask our team about MFA options for your setup.
In India, by default. Traffic, logs and policy data stay on Indian soil, with no overseas routing.
